headline: Cadence blog introduces Verilog-A tutorials for analog circuit blocks
fact: A Cadence official blog introduces Verilog-A teaching material for circuit and functional blocks, including ADCs, DACs, operational transconductance amplifiers, phase detectors and signal sources. It discusses Laplace- and Z-transform modeling for transfer functions. The Event dates the blog introduction, not the initial publication of every linked video, and is limited to circuit-block modeling rather than the device examples also mentioned in the article.

sources.title: Analog circuit modeling using Verilog-A in Virtuoso
sources.summary: Official article dated May 6, 2026 introduces circuit-block tutorials and transfer-function models. Some linked teaching videos require customer access; their full contents and first publication dates were not verified.
